title: Volume Conjecture
exact_target: Do the exponential growth rates of normalized colored Jones evaluations at the specified roots of unity recover the volumes of all hyperbolic knot complements?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1333 (TOP-003). CC BY 4.0.

Hitoshi Murakami and Jun Murakami, \emph{The colored Jones polynomials and the simplicial volume of a knot}, Acta Mathematica 186 (2001), 85--104; arXiv:math/9905075v2, introduction and Section 5, Conjecture 5.1 and Remark 5.2.
